request.description: Public endpoint. Generate sig = HMAC-SHA256(raw_body, WEBHOOK_SECRET). Duplicate/replayed deliveries must return {"status":"duplicate"} and never open a second ad period. Bad signature → 401.
finance/super_admin only. Captures transfer_id for approve/reject.
Approves the transfer → payment recorded, ad goes live, owner notified.
Rejects with a reason → owner may re-upload the receipt.
amount=null → full refund: gateway refund call + ad period cancelled + listing hidden.

item.name: Contracts & Handovers (Phase 4)
item.description: Contracts (draft → dual OTP confirm → immutable SHA-256 → Arabic PDF + QR), handovers (check-in/out), public /verify.

request.description: Handovers of a contract (+ check-out pairing)
Arabic PDF (party only, after both confirm)
Send the final text to the other party
Confirm a handover with a fresh OTP
Upload photo/video for a handover room
